# @temelj/cache

> 标签: cache, lru

## 简介

A fast in-memory cache. Includes LRU, MRU, SLRU, LFU, FIFO and RR.

- 源码仓库：https://github.com/tinrab/temelj
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@temelj/cache
